claims.statement: Binance Poland sp. z o.o. was entered in Poland's pre-MiCA virtual-currency activity register on 2022-09-29.
limitations: This was not a MiCA CASP authorisation.

claims.statement: Under the pre-MiCA Polish regime, KNF did not license, register, supervise or approve crypto exchanges such as Binance Poland merely because they appeared in the virtual-currency register.
claims.notes: Prevents old register entry from being promoted into a licence claim.

claims.statement: Poland's Article 143(3) MiCA transitional period ended on 2026-07-01.
claims.notes: Current legal analysis must use post-transition MiCA rules.

claims.statement: After the transitional period, provision of MiCA crypto-asset services in the EU requires an Article 59/63 authorisation or an applicable Article 60 status; grandfathering does not itself constitute MiCA authorisation.
claims.notes: This is the governing authorization rule for the Poland market after 2026-07-01.

claims.statement: ESMA's Interim MiCA Register landing page was updated on 2026-07-16 and identifies the authorised-CASP register as the primary central register sourced from national competent authorities.
limitations: The CSV itself was not parseable through the available research tool in this run.
claims.notes: Primary source exists, but row-level Binance lookup was not independently completed.

claims.statement: This research run could not independently confirm a current Binance MiCA/CASP authorisation usable for Poland from a directly parsed ESMA authorised-CASP row or a clearly bound Binance official licence disclosure.
limitations: ESMA register landing page was verified, but the linked CSV could not be parsed with available tooling.
The accessible Binance licences capture did not expose a Poland/MiCA row; this is not treated as proof of absence.
claims.notes: Fail-closed: no positive Poland legal-availability authorisation from this record.

claims.statement: On 2026-07-09 Reuters quoted Binance co-CEO Richard Teng saying Binance remained in close talks with EU regulators after withdrawing its Greek MiCA application and was pursuing another authorisation path.
limitations: Secondary source; does not replace direct ESMA register evidence.
claims.notes: Corroborates, but does not independently decide, current MiCA status.

claims.statement: Financial Times reported on 2026-08-06 that Binance had not received EU approval under MiCA.
limitations: Secondary reporting; the ESMA CASP register is the primary authority.

claims.statement: A public Binance P2P interface for USDT/PLN was reachable on the checked date.
limitations: Public surface visibility is not legal authorization or proof of resident onboarding eligibility.
claims.notes: Do not promote to market availability.

claims.statement: A Polish-language Binance P2P page naming Santander Poland as a payment method was publicly reachable on the checked date.
limitations: Does not prove a Polish resident can complete onboarding or legally use P2P.

claims.statement: A Polish-language Binance spot BTC/USDT page was publicly reachable on the checked date.
limitations: Reachability does not prove Poland resident eligibility or MiCA authorisation.

claims.statement: Binance's current KYC guidance says accounts have restricted trading and withdrawal functionality until identity verification is completed.
Binance's June 2026 P2P guidance says all Binance P2P users must complete identity verification (KYC).
limitations: Not proof that P2P is authorised or available for Polish residents.

claims.statement: Poland-facing Binance web/P2P surfaces demonstrate technical/public reachability only; they do not by themselves establish legal authorisation, registration success, or product eligibility for a Polish resident.
claims.notes: Inference from legal authorization requirements plus publicly visible surfaces.

claims.statement: Successful new-account onboarding and ordinary crypto-service availability for a Polish resident are not proven by this evidence set and must remain under review until current MiCA/CASP authority is bound to Binance and Poland.
limitations: No account creation or login testing performed.
Primary ESMA authorised-CASP CSV row-level lookup was not completed by the available tool.
claims.notes: This is the controlling MarketProfile posture from this research record.

claims.statement: Poland-specific Binance referral, promo-code and bonus eligibility are not established by the current research; CBW's globally owner-confirmed Binance link/code authority is not country eligibility evidence.
limitations: No referral submission, account test or campaign eligibility test was performed.
claims.notes: Research/product authority remains separate from #269 owner-confirmed global commercial identity.
